about_the_game:
Dungeon-Pix is a stylized VR dungeon escape game filled with puzzles, minigames and physical interactions only possible in virtual reality

You wake up deep inside a forgotten dungeon and the only way out is forward
Solve environmental puzzles, avoid traps, and face strange enemies using motion-based mechanics
Everything in the world is designed to be touched grabbed or dodged with your own hands

No static menus here
Activate your 3D menu by crossing your hands
Reload your gun by pointing it at the ground
Drop it and it floats back up to meet you

Current features include

  • Fully immersive VR interaction

  • A growing collection of unique minigames

  • A heartbeat-based health system that reacts to damage

  • Floating weapon recovery and motion-based reload

  • Stylized low-poly art with a dark fantasy atmosphere

Dungeon-Pix is currently in development and will continue to evolve based on feedback
Join the journey and help shape the dungeon
